brief: The canvas presents a serene, bright white space, into which pure black liquid ink slowly permeates. The movement is entirely internal and non-interactive. From the outer edges, the ink gradually begins to pull inward, gathering mass until it converges upon a central focal point. As the ink accumulates, its boundaries do not remain liquid; instead, they spontaneously solidify and resolve into a complex, hyper-ordered geometric pattern. This progression happens in highly controlled, sequential steps, mimicking the precise, cascading failure of a domino line, creating a structure that sustains itself purely through geometric order.

statement: This sketch depicts the slow, mesmerizing process of ink permeating a white space, gradually pulling inward from the edges toward a central point. As the liquid ink accumulates, it transforms into an ordered geometric pattern, like dominoes falling in sequence. The viewer observes the controlled progression of particles moving inward, forming increasingly complex shapes that maintain their structural integrity through pure geometric order. The work explores themes of transformation and emergence, where chaos gives way to mathematical precision as the system evolves over time.
